acceptanceCriteria: A dogfoodflow test runs a staged second citation plan naming only previously unknown hunks and asserts the 'plan was added to citations' note and the accumulated citations.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1465 (dftool-1021m, seal 3fadf4395, base 58d4ed2d3). DCW-V0-117 now refuses a citation plan row that re-cites an already cited hunk, so the 'plan was added to citations' note is only reachable through staged plans that name unknown hunks. Expected: a test asserts that note positively on a staged second plan. Actual: only the refusal cases are tested.
title: No test asserts the staged-plan 'plan was added to citations' note after DCW-V0-117
